description: Apple has reportedly increased its foldable iPhone display orders to up to 20 million units from Samsung Display, indicating strong demand ahead of its expected 2026 launch. The handset is likely to feature a 7.8-inch inner display, a 5.5-inch outer screen, and an iPad-like interface with multitasking support. It is expected to run on Apple’s 2nm A20 Pro chipset with a C2 modem. The foldable iPhone may also include dual rear and front cameras and could be marketed as the iPhone Ultra.
title: Apple Reportedly Boosts Foldable Panel Orders to 20 Million, Suggesting Strong Demand for Foldable iPhone

description: Argentina has blocked access to crypto-based prediction platform Polymarket, saying it operates outside the country’s regulated gambling and financial systems. Regulators flagged risks related to consumer protection and oversight, adding to growing global scrutiny of prediction markets using digital assets.
title: Argentina Bans Polymarket Over Unregulated Crypto Betting Concerns: Report

description: Instagram, on Tuesday, announced that it is bringing a new AI-powered feature to its app, dubbed AI Voice Effects. The new tool allows users to add filters to their voice notes in direct messages (DMs), once they have recorded them. Gadgets360 staff members were able to verify that the new feature is now live in India. Users can choose from a list of eight AI Voice Effects, dubbed “Chipmunk”, “Demon”, “Alien”, “Robot”, Underwater”, “Stadium”, “Wobble”, and “Fishbowl”. However, they can also remove the filter by clicking on the "Original" button.
title: Instagram Rolls Out New AI Voice Effects For Voice Notes With Eight Filters

description: The iQOO 15R is a return to the "flagship killer" philosophy, with an emphasis on pure speed and battery life. The phone responds quickly at all times, with a smooth screen and battery life that essentially eliminates battery anxiety. The cameras may not be the best around, nor is the software the cleanest with a healthy dose of bloatware, but it’s a top-shelf recommendation nonetheless.
title: iQOO 15R Review: Maximum Speed, Minimum Compromise

description: The OnePlus Pad 3 was launched in the global markets in June 2025, and it could be joined by another model soon. According to a tipster, the company is preparing to expand its tablet lineup with the introduction of the OnePlus Pad 3 Pro. It is expected to succeed the Snapdragon 8 Elite-powered OnePlus Pad 2 Pro, which debuted in China last year. The OnePlus Pad 3 Pro is tipped to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: OnePlus Pad 3 Tipped to Launch With 13.2-Inch Display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip

description: Oppo Find N6 has launched in China and select global markets as a book-style foldable with a claimed crease-free inner display. It features an 8.12-inch inner screen and a 6.62-inch cover display, both supporting high refresh rates and HDR formats. The phone is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, paired with up to 16GB RAM and 1TB storage. It packs a 6,000mAh battery with fast charging and includes a quad rear camera setup led by a 200-megapixel primary sensor and a 50-megapixel periscope lens.
title: Oppo Find N6 Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Oppo Watch X3 launched with a 1.5-inch LTPO OLED display. It runs on a Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 chipset and has IP68 and IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. It provides more than 100 sports modes and has sensors to track heart rate and blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) levels. The new smartwatch carries a 646mAh battery. It boasts a 646mAh battery, and it is claimed to deliver up to 16 days of battery life in power saver mode.
title: Oppo Watch X3 With Snapdragon W5 Chipset, Over 100 Sports Modes Launched

description: Poco X8 Pro series has been launched in India by the Chinese smartphone maker. The new lineup is scheduled to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The Poco X8 Pro series has been unveiled with supports 100W wired fast charging. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset powers the Poco X8 Pro Max 5G. On the other hand, the Poco X8 Pro 5G is equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra SoC, which is built on a 4nm process. Both handsets carry dual rear camera units, with 50-megapixel main shooters.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Launched in India With Up to 9,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Realme P4 Lite 5G is set to launch in India on March 19. Here's a quick roundup about the launch details, expected price, specifications, and features of the upcoming P series smartphone. It will be available for purchase in the country via Flipkart, the company's India website, and offline stores. It will be released in Mosaic Blue and Mosaic Green colourways. It will ship with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset and a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Realme P4 Lite 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Specifications

description: Smriti Irani’s Alliance for Global Good has partnered with the British Council to empower Indian women entrepreneurs. This MoU, part of the Spark 100K Collective launched in 2025, focuses on boosting "funds, freedom, and scale." The British Council will provide vital English language and digital communication training to help women entrepreneurs enhance their skills and grow their businesses.
title: Smriti Irani Backs Women Entrepreneurs With SPARK Collective Push and British Council Partnership

description: Vivo X500 series, which is expected to be launched later this year by the Chinese smartphone maker, will include three models, instead of two, according to a tipster. The lineup might feature Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max models. This suggests that the company could be moving away from earlier precedents, as last year’s Vivo X300 series comprises the Vivo X300 and Vivo X300 Pro models only. On top of this, the tech firm will reportedly equip the standard model with a different chipset than the Pro and Pro Max models.
title: Vivo X500 Series Chipsets Tipped Months Ahead of Launch; Vivo Pro Max Could Also Debut

description: This list covers some of the best duplex laser printers you can buy for homes and small offices in India in 2026. It includes options from HP, Canon, and Brother, ranging from basic print-only models to all-in-one machines with scanning and copying. Most of these printers offer automatic duplex printing, speeds of up to 34 pages per minute, and are built for regular use. Some focus on keeping costs low, while others add more features like wireless connectivity, mobile printing, and better paper handling for everyday convenience.
title: Best Duplex Laser Printers for Homes, Small Offices in 2026

description: Finnish health technology company Oura launched its first smart ring in India on Tuesday. The wearable, dubbed Oura Ring 4, debuted in global markets around two years ago and marks the brand’s foray into India’s health and fitness wearables market. Like the global model, the smart ring focuses on health tracking, sleep analysis, and recovery insights. It is compatible with the Oura App and supports Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) connectivity. Oura Ring 4 is equipped with Smart Sensing technology for accurate health and activity readings.
title: Oura Ring 4 Launched in India With Smart Sensing Technology and HRV Tracking: Price, Specifications

description: Sony has announced that the upgraded version of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) is now rolling out to more games as part of a PS5 system update. The upscaling technology will now support Silent Hill f, Silent Hill 2, Crimson Desert, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, Alan Wake 2, and other games on PS5 Pro.
title: Sony's Upgraded PSSR Upscaler Is Rolling Out to Silent Hill f, Crimson Desert and More Games on PS5 Pro

description: Multiple tech and retail giants signed an agreement to combat rising online scams and fraud on Monday. The accord was signed at the UN Global Fraud Summit in Vienna, and the signatories include the likes of Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, and others. As part of the agreement, the companies have pledged to work together and share intelligence about how bad actors are abusing the services.
title: Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Others Join Hands to Fight Online Scams and Fraud

description: Oppo K14 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the China-based smartphone maker’s K-series. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Oppo India online store. It will be available for purchase in India in Icy Blue, Prism Violet, and Prism White colour options. The new Oppo K14 5G is backed by a 7,000mAh battery. It also features support for 45W wired fast charging. The phone is powered by the octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, along with up to 8GB of RAM and up to 256GB of onboard storage.
title: Oppo K14 5G Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Law enforcement agencies from the US, UK, and Canada have launched a joint operation to combat crypto-related fraud. The initiative focuses on tackling cross-border scams, including phishing and investment fraud schemes, through coordinated enforcement and intelligence sharing.
title: Operation Atlantic: Canada, UK and US Conduct Joint Operation to Disrupt Crypto Fraud Networks

title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Watch This Film Online

Now, Samsung is reportedly winding down the sales of its Galaxy Z TriFold smartphone in Korea. It will reportedly discontinue the device in the US once the existing inventory is sold. The Galaxy Z TriFold features a 6.5-inch cover display, and it runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold Sales Set to End Just Three Months After Launch: Report

A recent leak from a tipster highlights its “small-screen flagship” positioning, pointing to a compact design similar to the 6.3-inch Xiaomi 17 Pro. Other expected features include an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, wireless charging, and water resistance. The Xiaomi 18 series is also tipped to use the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 lineup and could launch in China in September.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Tipped to Feature 7,000mAh Battery Along With Two 200-Megapixel Rear Cameras

description: Bitcoin traded near the $74,000 level on Tuesday as the crypto market held firm amid steady institutional demand and ETF inflows. Analysts said accumulation by large investors continues to support prices, though resistance near $75,000 remains a key hurdle. Ethereum and major altcoins showed mixed movement as investors tracked macroeconomic signals and awaited a clearer breakout.
title: Crypto Market Holds Firm as Bitcoin Tests Key Resistance Levels

The handset, seen at a company event in China, reveals a simpler design with a triple rear camera setup and prominent Legion branding. This would be Lenovo’s first Legion phone since the 2022 Legion Y70. While specifications are not confirmed, it is expected to target flagship performance with high-end hardware and advanced cooling if launched.
title: Lenovo Legion Phone Spotted in Leaked Live Images That Hint at Gaming Line Revival

This deal would bring OpenAI’s business tools to many different companies owned by these firms. It helps OpenAI grow faster in the corporate world while helping the investment firms protect their businesses from being left behind by new AI technology.
title: OpenAI Courts Private Equity to Join Enterprise AI Venture, Sources Say

description: Vivo T5x 5G has been launched in India with MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset and a 7,200mAh battery with 44W fast charging support. The Vivo T5x 5G ships with IP68 and IP69 ratings and has a 6.67-inch display. It will go on sale from March 24 across Flipkart, vivo India e-store, and all partner retail stores. It is launched in Cyber Green and Star Silver colour options.
title: Vivo T5x 5G Launched in India With 7,200mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300s are said to go official on March 30 in China. The Vivo Pad 6 Pro is tipped to launch alongside these new smartphones. All new devices could go on sale on April 3. Vivo could open pre-orders for the new smartphones and tablet from March 23. The Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300s are said to feature up to 16GB RAM and up to 1TB onboard storage.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300s Launch Date and Memory Configurations Leaked; Vivo Pad 6 Pro Might Tag Along

description: Nvidia introduced NemoClaw, an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered stack for the OpenClaw agents, on Monday. The announcement was made at the company’s annual GPU Technology Conference (GTC) during the keynote session. NemoClaw essentially adds privacy and security guardrails to OpenClaw’s AI agents, making them deployable and scalable for enterprises. The Santa Clara, California-based tech giant highlighted that the AI stack can be installed with a single command and is platform and agent agnostic.
title: Nvidia Introduces NemoClaw, an AI Stack to Make OpenClaw Agents More Secure

description: Nvidia unveiled its DLSS 5 graphics upscaling technology on Monday to severe online backlash from gamers. The company called DLSS 5, which utilises an AI-powered real-time neural rendering model, a "breakthrough" in graphics, but many games took to X and called it an "AI slop filter".
title: Nvidia Unveils DLSS 5 Graphics Upscaler, Issues Clarification After Backlash Over 'AI Slop Filter'

description: OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 13s smartphones have started receiving OxygenOS 16.0.5.700 software update in India. The update comes with the March 2026 Android security patch. The OxygenOS 16.0.5.700 for the OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 13s allow users to start multiple timers simultaneously for more efficient multitasking. Timers now display estimated stop times. Content Portal now supports app clones for quick content sharing.
title: OnePlus 15, OnePlus 13s Receive Latest OxygenOS 16 Update in India With March 2026 Security Fixes

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra is set to go official in China and the global markets soon. While the company has been revealing details in the days leading up to its launch, specifications of the upcoming handset have now leaked in full. According to a report, it will be equipped with a 6.82-inch LTPO AMOLED screen. Powering the handset will be the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, coupled with 16GB of RAM. The Find X9 Ultra is confirmed to pack a 7,050mAh battery.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Specifications Leaked in Detail Ahead of Global Launch

The Poco X8 Pro Max 5G and Poco X8 Pro 5G will reportedly be sold in the country in two RAM and storage configurations each. title: Poco X8 Pro Series Price in India Leaked Alongside Storage Variants Hours Ahead of Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G has been launched in India by the South Korean company as its new mid-range smartphone. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country at 12 pm IST today via Amazon. The phone is Blitz Blue and Vibe Violet colour options. The new Galaxy M17e 5G is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. It is also equipped with a 6,000mAh battery. The handset carries a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter. It also features a 2-megapixel depth sensor on the back. On the front, it gets an 8-megapixel selfie camera, housed inside a waterdrop-style notch.
title: Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Features

description: Tecno Spark Go 3 was recently unveiled in India. In the 10,000 price segment, the handset offers decent overall performance for its price. However, as smartphone component prices have risen incessantly, phones across segments have become more expensive. Last year, it would have been easier to recommend the Tecno Spark Go 3 to somebody looking for a budget phone. But that’s no longer the case. The tech firm evidently had to cut corners on multiple fronts.
title: Tecno Spark Go 3 Review: Last of the Sub-Rs. 10,000 Budget Phones?

description: Vivo has announced that it will increase the prices of its various smartphone models in China, along with its sub-brand iQOO, according to a public letter seen by a Weibo user. In the purported letter, the Chinese smartphone maker said that the decision was taken to offset the rising prices of semiconductors and memory components. The increased retail prices of Vivo and iQOO handsets in China will reportedly come into effect on March 18 at 10:00 am local time (7:30 am IST). This comes shortly after a report highlighted that Oppo and OnePlus are also increasing the prices of smartphones in China.
title: Vivo, iQOO Smartphones to Get More Expensive in China as Component Prices Continue to Rise: Report

description: AirPods Max 2 were launched on Monday as Apple's latest over-ear headphones. The successor to AirPods Max has been introduced five years after the original model’s debut. They are powered by the new H2 chip, which also powers the latest-generation AirPods Pro. According to the Cupertino-based tech giant, the updated model delivers improvements to Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode, and overall audio performance, while retaining the original AirPods Max's premium design.
title: AirPods Max 2 Launched in India With H2 Chip, Adaptive Audio, and 20-Hour Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: The lower end of the mid-range segment offers decent value for your hard-earned money. But not all of these match their current-day pricing in India. title: Best Mobiles Under Rs. 25,000 in India: From Redmi Note 15, OnePlus Nord CE 5, Vivo T4 and More

description: The iQOO Z11 is expected to go official in China soon as the latest addition to the Z-series family. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the upcoming handset has been spotted on a benchmarking site, which hints at some of its specifications and details its capabilities. It is listed with the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 processor. The iQOO Z11 runs on the latest Android 16 firmware and could ship with OriginOS 6 out of the box.
